Read about the board.
Read about the model.
Read about the service.
Check the meeting notes for anything newer.
Weights: 7.2e9 x 2 bytes = 14.4 GB, read at 900 GB/s.
KV cache: 8 users x 4096 tokens x 0.5 MB, in GB.

script.final: (1) About 16 ms per decode step: 14.4 GB of weights at 900 GB/s. (2) The KV cache needs about 16.4 GB for 8 users at 4096 tokens, but only 7.6 GB is left after the weights and the 2 GB reserve, so it does not fit; about 3 users would.
